verdict.rationale: ClickUp lists Docs as a first-party product, and its Docs sit in the same workspace as tasks, Lists and Folders. Workspace search spans tasks and Docs, and Figma prototypes can be embedded in Docs for real-time collaboration, so the product clearly hosts docs alongside project work. However, the evidence gives only thin mentions: there is no documentation of how docs are created, organized or shared, and no hands-on corroboration. Missing for 10: documented doc creation and editing, doc organization or hierarchy, sharing and collaborative-editing details, notes functionality, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can create and organize shared docs and notes alongside my project work
